summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K solely to furnish a press release providing a business update on its ROAMEO autonomous security vehicles. The release details deployment pipeline growth and production readiness, with expectations of seven revenue-generating units by year-end 2026 and an internal goal of 50 units by August 2027. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The filing is a routine operational update without financial terms or strategic actions, thus not qualifying as a special situation.
